perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.desc: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.desc: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Detonator Beam
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target.

perks.name: Skulking Wolf
perks.desc: While at low health, final blows with this weapon grant enhanced radar, remove you from opposing Guardians' radar, and make combatants less aggressive toward you.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 133 from 11 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/49VFDRj05iDXTJDOBqQpga?si=e61731a19fb64938) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for use against Minor add groups in both general at-level or better, and end-game underlevelled content, particularly with arc builds. There are a few legendary adaptive frame trace rifles available now, and Warlord's Spear is not a bad arc variant. At base, the stats are good by comparison with its peers - 67 Range and 16 Zoom equate to 34.51m ADS and 21.57m hipfire, 76 Stability is ×1.2575 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 55 Handling is 0.37s ready, 0.29s ADS and 0.34s stow speed, 33 Reload Speed is a 2.01s reload and Recoil Direction is 93. Base magazine size is 97 (Max 104) and, with 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 525/575/626/641 (max 687). Use the barrel perk to improve Handling (M+KB) or Stability (Controller), and then either a battery perk to boost capacity or Stability or something to help with reload speed. In the first trait perk column, Rewind Rounds is probably the pick of the utility perks, although Envious Assassin or Loose Change are very decent alternatives. For arc builds, Jolting Feedback is great to apply Jolt for both single target damage and add clearing, proccing after 18 hits (17 when the perk's enhanced and 13 when amplified), to synergise with arc fragments. The reworked Skulking Wolf origin trait can be useful in PvE, making enemies less accurate when firing at you for 10s after getting a kill while at low health. Recommended MW: Handling with a Backup Mag mod or, when fully enhanced, Synergy to create Ionic Traces or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "What a fun little trace rifle. I would recommend Rewind Rounds with Killing Tally to make the most of your ammo while supplementing your builds. Or you can go High-Impact Reserves with Target Lock to really deal damage into bosses. The newest perk, Detonator Beam, looks to be a trace rifle equivalent of Kinetic Tremors. Definitely a good perk to try out." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Trace rifles have seen less usage thanks to the special ammo changes a while back. The lower ammo count really hurts these weapons. Bungie keeps trying to adjust them but they're only fun when you can run around with them as a primary suped up auto rifle. Dynamic Sway Reduction will help the bloom and accuracy, though High-Impact Reserves will be nice every time you spawn dealing extra damage." Recommended MW: Range.
